title: It Just Gets Worse
desc_lfm_artist:
There are at least two artists called A.C.
1.AC is an MC from North West London. He has already sold over 45,000 cds on the road and considers Mobb Deep and MOP as influences. He used to be part of the Mentor Kolektiv and AC & Terra. He is now solo.
2. A.C. is the old name for A.C. is Air Conditioning. He is an Electronic/Folktronica artist. He has Listed James Yuill, New Order and Metronomy as influences. 
His first EP entitled Practice EP is on bandcamp and was released 9/15/12.

title: Whore Splattered Walls
desc_lfm_artist:
Grindcore/Goregrind/Brutal Death Metal/Noise band from USA, San Antonio, Texas.

They call their style Absurd DeathNoiseGrind.

The band is active since 1996.

The band released their first demo, (Savage Vaginal Shredding) in 1997.

The band recorded their first full-length album (Drowned in Rectal Sludge) during the week of December 12th, 1999 and subsequently released it March 22nd, 2000.

Topics the band deals with are Misogyny, Gore, Sex, Murder, Fetishism (early); H.P. Lovecraft (later).
